candidates.lease_name: TREES, J. C. ESTATE, ET AL -A-

quality.duplicate_policy: Every source row retained. The only duplicate rule is a repeated source id within one response: every occurrence is flagged duplicate_source_id and quarantined. Rows identical apart from id, record_sequence or date (the same string re-filed) are normal and unflagged. No preferred row is selected or merged.
quality.empty_result_policy: No plugging rows were returned by the exact-API query; this does not show whether the well is or is not plugged.
quality.presence_policy: Only whether rows were returned is stated. Rows returned or not returned say nothing about casing, cementing or plugging status.
quality.record_sequence_policy: record_sequence is a filing sequence shared by several rows; it is not a row key, repeats are normal and never flagged, and it is kept verbatim without being used for ordering beyond the source order (record_sequence,id).
quality.on_top_record_policy: on_top_record is true only where the source sets it; absent in source is shown empty (not false) with no flag; a non-boolean value is a quarantined parse failure; it is never derived from record_sequence or a date.
